text.tspan: UPPER JOINT CONCEPT / FASTENER CENTERS, SIZES AND REACTION GEOMETRY UNRESOLVED
Actual dimensions, string data and load-path review required before fabrication or tensioning.
Dashed red components reserve a review zone; they are not fabrication geometry.
Tuner model, string end type, mounting thickness and fastener
String run from winding post to nut; break angle and individual
Head block and shoulder geometry, grain, contact area and slip
Bolt diameter, gauge along z, hole fits, end/edge margins and
Coupled bolt tension/shear, prying, bearing, splitting, net section
Guard, winding tool and string replacement swept envelopes.
At a nut or bridge, use the vector sum of the tensions in the adjacent string segments. The bearing reaction is not automatically
equal to one string tension. The total upper subassembly still transfers the full string resultant into the frame.
The PDF CX-1 hardware remains a candidate. No drill diameter, torque, metal
grade substitution or operating load is released on this sheet.
